title: A quest's status: offered, taken, handed in (the client's prediction of it)
oneLine: rpg._quests per quest: available/active/turnedIn, predicted on the phone with gold, XP, AP, then the worker's word
topConcern: Four of six worker turn-in refusals are silent (objective unmet among them); a v2 phone keeps its predicted hand-in, gold, AP and next step

title: The tracked quest (one id, cached, shared with other tabs)
oneLine: bt_trackedQuest: read-once latch, cached id, storage-event listener, subscribers
topConcern: Per browser, never cleared on hand-in or character change; inert because readers check membership

title: Where the gold road leads (welcome, tour suggestion, a quest's way, you-are-there, hand-in)
oneLine: Per-frame road phase derived from quests, position, _rpgFromServer and the tracked id
topConcern: Road, log and journal disagree on quests in hand; an old save's dormant active quest blocks the tour suggestion forever

title: Quest Complete! over the head (edge watcher, once per quest per page)
oneLine: 2 Hz poll of ready quests with a seen-set; announces each once a page
topConcern: clearQuestCompleteSeen, documented as called from the turn-in path, has no caller; polls before the first player_state

title: A reward picture's flight (take off, fly, land, pulse)
oneLine: DOM picture flights with a once-only done latch fed by onfinish, oncancel and a timeout

title: The ground road's look (put away unless ?questpath)
oneLine: Trail style and last-shown style; reads off for everyone since v2.3.2992

title: Achievements on the phone (the worker's record, a title ask, the banner queue)
oneLine: S._achv: known/unavailable, got, ap, a 4 s title ask, a capped banner queue with give-up
topConcern: AP total falls back to the phone's own +5-predicted achievementPoints before the worker's ap arrives

title: A mystery piece's reveal on the phone (asked, playing, landed; the equip that waits)
oneLine: _then/_held/_after module maps carry a reveal ask, its ceremony and held achievements
topConcern: An ask dropped while offline leaves _then with no exit; a later reveal of that key (a bag index for blades) runs the old equip

title: The daily spin's pot (spin, double or nothing, collect) and the daily-rewards holder
oneLine: Worker pot open/pot/k with opIds; phone holds last state and spin answer, wheel waits 8 s
topConcern: Worker drops acts silently inside its 450 ms cooldown though it promises every act an answer; the wheel says timeout after 8 s

title: A harvest attempt: wind-up (hits or timer), ready for the gesture, struck or cancelled
oneLine: S._extraction waiting/hits/ready/struck; the strike predicted on the phone (node falls, XP, popups)
topConcern: Silent node_strike refusals leave the node invisible (never dirty in v2) and phantom XP; a gesture can finish while dead

title: A bed on your farm and the step you take at it
oneLine: Worker bed rough/tilled/planted/ripe; phone near-bed, timed step, farm_act with a 4 s answer timeout
topConcern: Ripe is judged on the phone's offset clock; farmBus clears pending on any farm_state

title: The farm's loading hold (feet held until the farm's art is in, at most 12 s)
oneLine: S._farmArtHold seq lifted only by its own preload or the 12 s cap
topConcern: Nothing clears the hold on a zone change; leaving mid-hold keeps feet still up to 12 s

title: What the farm says back (ripe-beds news, the crop's flight, a client quest flag)
oneLine: toldRipe counter, an 8 s last-step window, and a phone-only _questFlags.harvestedCrop
topConcern: The phone-only quest flag is wiped by the worker's next full state; dormant (Trader Tix's quest only)

title: A trap on a monster: asked, armed, sprung or kept, the catch revealed
oneLine: S._trap pending/mark/springs/hidePet/card; the worker owns the mark and every roll
topConcern: An expired mark is never cleared, keeping TrapFx's per-frame path alive; result timers run after a zone change

title: A loot pile on the ground: spawned, magnet, asked, credited, despawned
oneLine: Per-pile underscore flags (anchor, pending, retry, collected, despawn) and a legacy self-credit path
topConcern: Piles without _serverLoot are still credited by the phone; the tick's local remains pile isn't gated on _serverLoot like monster_kill's

title: A kill's drop lines (the credit and the pile, matched by the monster)
oneLine: S._dlCredits and S._dropLines match combat_credit to loot_drop by monster id within 3 s
topConcern: A pile later than 400 ms after its credit shows the nugget line twice

title: Your own dropped item (private, public, flashing, gone; held until you step off)
oneLine: Worker drop clocks; phone _leftIt latch so a drop at your feet waits

title: Standing in a burning heap (the look, and a paced report)
oneLine: S._heapBurnUntil look and S._heapBurnSentAt pacing of heap_burn

title: The XP bar in the top bar (shown, pop, level wrap, gone; fraction carried)
oneLine: S._xpBar from the worker's prog3 blobs; S._xpCarry holds fractions per skill
topConcern: The carry goes negative on purpose and is repaid only by later gains of that skill

title: The character level-up celebration's high-water (and its pool refill)
oneLine: _lastShownLevel and _lastCharLvlShown, four writers, once-a-page baseline flag
topConcern: Celebration refills HP/stamina/mana on the phone; two stamps written from four places

title: Mastery level and certifications (stored in this browser only)
oneLine: Monotonic mastery tier and certificate set, hydrated once from localStorage
topConcern: Not per character: a second character or a restart inherits the tier and firsts; two tabs overwrite each other

title: A vault move at the Bank (asked, waiting at most 4 s, answered)
oneLine: S._bankPending with opId and 4 s busy window; S._bank as the last bank_state
topConcern: The phone never resends an opId, so the worker's opId record guards nothing it does

title: A Gem Works ask and a salvage/essence receipt
oneLine: Module pending with 4 s expiry and last-answer buses; salvage edits the phone's armour lists
topConcern: Salvage keeps the phone's armour list in step by hand; a missed receipt leaves the piece

title: The smith at work (timed visual hold)
oneLine: S._smithing until, extended by re-press, ended by time, moving or death

title: The fish weigh-in card (Inspect, weighing, the weight, closed)
oneLine: Module card where open means card non-null; pending key and board want
topConcern: A late fish_weight re-opens a closed card; an unanswered ask reads Weighing forever
